title: ESB Puerto Rico Corp
description: esbpr.com ESB Puerto Rico Corp is a distributor of automotive and industrial products that has served Puerto Rico since 1965 ("Energizando a Puerto Rico desde 1965"); it is headquartered in Carolina, PR, is a Hispanic-/minority-owned small business and a federal contractor (CAGE 3DPU1). Its portfolio spans automotive, traction and stationary/backup batteries, tires, lubricants and DEF, AUTEL diagnostics, tools, plus Hyundai and EP forklifts, warehouse equipment, rental, maintenance, OEM parts and e-commerce — a "one-stop source" for material handling, automotive and industrial operations in Puerto Rico and the Virgin Islands, representing ~9 brands (including Eternity Technologies). The president is Omar Aponte; the company stays lean (under ~25 staff, ~$2M revenue) and handles ~150 sea import shipments a year, mostly from Asia.
